[u][b]The Federal Republic of Hatorre Announces the Adoption of the New Trade Law[/b][/u]

Today, the Hatorre Parliament approved the new Law on International Trade Relations, relaxing many of the country's protectionist and tariff policies. This will allow for opening to the international market and renewing oil contracts with Erene countries. The Maguadiz oil field is one of the most abundant in Southern Vespuria, and is expected to lead to increased tax revenue and an improvement in the national economy.

The new Trade Law eliminates certain prerequisites for friendship and cooperation treaties and grants Hatorrean companies freedom to import and export, subject to some regulations from the Hatorre Regulatory Agency. This decision has been applauded by the country's leading business leaders.

Those numbers may seem like a lot, but it's really lucky because 1,203 rounds were fired, from many different guns including Ak-47s, Desert Eagles, Glocks, and 4 UZIs. These guns were all connected to a gun store in the former country of Eastornia-Kolionia." The new investigation branch, WVCIB (Western View Complete Ivestigation Bureau), a combination of all other branches of investigation, has found the shooters to be 29 men a part of Hatzur Zatsugi's group Guhui'Bernardio and of them 5 were Kolionian government officials. Due to the up coming election, this is not a good look for Mack Messiaon, but after interviewing many citizens out of every 3, 2 said that Mack could pull it together.[/spoiler]
